name: Komax Holding AG
summary: Komax Holding AG, together with its subsidiaries, provides automated wire processing solutions in the North and South America, Europe, the Asia/Pacific, and Africa. The company offers higher automation platform products, such as harness manufacturing, automatic crimping, wire twisting, process modules, high voltage platforms, and data wire platforms; and semi-automation machines for stripping, crimping, cutting, and custom automation for various wire types and sizes.
